title: Cruise Passengers: Is There Time for a Private Boat Trip in Funchal?
description: Usually yes. Ships dock at the Pontinha pier, the marina is a flat walk away, and the 10:00 Day Trip is back at 12:30, well before an afternoon all-aboard.
heroAlt: White motor boat leaving Funchal marina in the morning with a cruise ship docked behind
keywords: cruise passengers private boat trip funchal
funchal cruise port boat trip back on time
funchal cruise terminal to marina walk
boat trip from funchal cruise ship

images.prompt: Morning at Funchal, Madeira, seen from the water just outside the marina entrance. A white 9 metre motor boat with grey cushioned seats and a dark canopy heads out to sea with a small white wake, a few small guests on deck seen from behind. In the background a large white cruise ship is docked along the long Pontinha pier, with the Funchal hillside of white houses rising behind. Clear morning light, calm blue sea, true colours, no logos readable on the ship.
images.alt: White motor boat leaving Funchal marina in the morning with a cruise ship docked behind

images.prompt: The Funchal seafront promenade in the morning, seen at eye level: a wide paved walkway along the sea with palm trees and the marina masts ahead, a few walkers seen from behind, the long cruise pier visible in the distance behind them.
images.alt: Seafront promenade in Funchal leading from the cruise pier towards the marina
